value_updates.warning_purpose: Clearly indicate that the report is confidential and for limited distribution
value_updates.warning_visual_treatment: Refined and less visually dominant while remaining clear

verdicts.decision_note: The client requires retaining the final-page confidentiality warning while reducing its visual dominance; the source does not establish application to all report variants.
The client further refines the warning's visual treatment so it remains clear and professional without overpowering the page or interfering with the footer.
